title: host.link@1
description: A host's link came up or went down (#999): the SSH link that forwards the host's hook socket to this hub. While it is down the host's deep-hook spools, and each of its sessions reads unknown, never finished; once it is back the hub replays that spool in order. Up, it names the version and contract the host's deep-hook reports and the hub's own, so a deep-hook a contract major apart from the hub says so on its sessions' rows and in deep doctor. Only the core appends it.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

host.description: The host, as your SSH config names it.

up.description: True once the forward is up; false when it ended or could not start.

why.description: Why it is down, in ssh's words where it gave any; null when it is up.

hook_version.description: The version the host's deep-hook reports (deep-hook --version); null when the link is down or it reported none.

hook_contract.description: The hub contract the host's deep-hook speaks, major.minor (deep-hook --contract); null when the link is down or it reported none, as a deep-hook older than the report does.

hub_version.description: The hub's own version; null when the link is down.

hub_contract.description: The hub contract the hub speaks, major.minor; null when the link is down.
